name: v16-locale-lowercase
change: No content change. Custom server maps /es-mx/products/connect/branded-call (lowercase region subtag, hyphen separator) to site/; responds 200 directly — no trailing-slash redirect. Lowercase region in locale tag (es-mx vs es-MX) is the violation under test (spec §10.2).
edit: serve.py only — custom prefix handler with /es-mx/products/connect/branded-call prefix, 200 on no-trailing-slash URL
diffSummary: site/ is byte-for-byte identical to golden/site/. Only serve.py differs (custom locale-lowercase path-prefix handler).
